create_static_quant_module_mapping: create a static quantized module class from a floating point module class using get_static_quant_module_class
create_dynamic_quant_module_mapping: create a dynamically quantized module class from a floating point module class using get_dynamic_quant_module_class
get_qat_module_mappings: get default quantization aware training module mappings for converting float modules to QAT modules
get_qconfig_propagation_list: get the default list of module types that receive qconfig attribute during quantization prepare step
get_quantized_operator: get the quantized operator corresponding to a floating point function or torch op
